contract.nativeOperation: whole source cell with integer translation only; exact RGBA bytes retained
contract.resampler: premultiplied Lanczos; no explicit alpha deletion or cleaning
contract.alphaCaveat: Original alpha is bit-for-bit preserved in native1024 frames. Downsampling changes samples/quantizes alpha normally; there is no alpha threshold edit, crop or removed component. The entire resized source rectangle is pasted and checked.
contract.map128hMeaning: Legacy tier name shared with metal exporter. Wood master measured alpha>16 silhouette is 118 pixels high in 384 canvas; no forced 128px fit. Pose heights remain natural.
contract.rootMethod: manual boot/knee contact ROIs -> two contact points -> integer-rounded midpoint; each grounded frame registered separately
contract.groundRootProofScope: contact midpoint aligns; foot articulation/stance width are not redrawn
contract.sourceCuts: Use explicit per-frame sourceRect. Non-uniform row cuts and attack row2 x1062 partition; do not uniform-grid auto-slice native sheets.

actions.sourceRectReason: Full sheet partition at visible empty gutters. Attack lower-row boundary x1062 keeps frame5 shield intact; equal-grid slicing would cut it.
